name: Coder
description: Self-hosted platform for creating and managing cloud development environments.

envVars.description: Public URL Coder is reachable at

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      CODER_PG_CONNECTION_URL: "postgresql://coder:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/coder?sslmode=disable"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      CODER_ACCESS_URL: {{env.CODER_ACCESS_URL}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/home/coder/.config/coderv2
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: coder
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: coder
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
